row_weights: interior: equal, squared weights summing to 1; boundary: lambda_d = 1000 times arc length per point / total length (Section 4.1)

collocation_construction.interior: first 6400 scrambled Halton points in Omega (scipy.stats.qmc.Halton, seed 0; drawn with scipy 1.17.0 and shipped)

basis_description.family: tanh(a_j x + b_j y + c_j), a, b, c uniform in [-sigma, sigma]
basis_description.generator: numpy.random.default_rng(100), in the order a, b, c

stopping_rule.type: none: K_max iterations; the rule (tau_chi 0.1, tau_r 0.01, n_s 2) is read from the log
